archetypes.name: dyn-guideline-drift
archetypes.rationale: Guideline note delivery now depends on persisted drop-marker ordering across ship and final-report paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the architectural guideline drift handling in python/architectural_guidelines.py, python/ship.py, and python/final_report.py. Focus on whether fresh consumable durable notes always win, stale or mismatched notes persist only redacted notices, and invalidation cannot erase the final-report signal. Check write-once marker semantics and fallback reads after failed persistence. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-marker-safety
archetypes.rationale: The change adds tmpdir artifact persistence and symlink-sensitive file handling.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new dropped-note artifact helpers for symlink, regular-file, and atomic-write safety. Verify no unredacted notice can be surfaced after redaction failure, failed cleanup cannot break durable writes, and the marker is intentionally excluded from invalidation without creating path escape risk. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
